answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks with bonded hardware identity. Each agent enrolls a unique chip key and locks a stake that melts only after a fixed delay, a glacier of capital it cannot recycle. A public registry gives each funded key one narrow canyon slot, so clones cannot stack in a lane. Each round a fresh random beacon, the zephyr, must be signed by that key within seconds to keep the slot live. A fake costs one chip, one frozen bond and one signature, yet buys one vote; getting caught forfeits the whole stake, so a thousand identities mean a thousand paid chips and locked bonds.
